starter_files.purpose: Record setup, user-facing behavior, test steps, and known limitations.
Entry point for a small implementation; split modules when that improves clarity.

stretch_features: Add automated tests for edge cases.
Document an architectural or accessibility decision.
Measure performance if relevant and retain evidence.
tests_and_validation: Test the happy path and edge cases.
Check empty/loading/error states if the project interacts with data or a network.
Check keyboard access and readable messages for browser interfaces.
Record exact local setup and verification commands.

review_method: Human review plus project-specific automated tests; do not claim automatic evaluation of a deployed app.
